name: Two Demon Catgirls: A Nocturne of Evil
source:
Meph and Stofel. Two charming catgirls. Immortal demons. The very embodiments of Evil, who have grown unbearably bored.
They have come to a lonely creator to play, tempt, and travel through dreams, history, and fantasies — gradually forcing him to see his own existence in an entirely different light.
translation:
梅菲与斯托菲尔——两只迷人的猫娘，不朽的恶魔。身为“邪恶”本身化身的她们，如今早已无聊到了极点。
她们降临到一位孤独创作者的身边，嬉戏玩闹、百般引诱，带他穿梭于梦境、历史与幻想之间——一步步迫使他用截然不同的眼光重新审视自身的存在。
